Pre-FIG figure parts (original 4f87d0) convert to FIG8 exactly; the Gipath ogre uses the early skull-belt hips only where its skins paint the skull, keeps every other part, and the early ogre loads for its cut-content preview with expanded bones and a Gipath skin.
The Esc signpost opens on the last frame of its rise clip, as the original shows it in place under Wine; the esc_menu_rise option (Gameplay, off by default, EN/RU/DE) plays the rise from below.
The Esc menu rise option row is localized in EN/RU/DE, above the page link, and its label and choices fit at 1280x720, 2560x1440 and 3840x2160 with native-resolution captures.

The name typed on the co-op and autochess multiplayer screens is saved to settings.cfg when the field is left, on Back, when the screen hides or the window closes, cleaned as hosting does; untouched or emptied fields keep the saved name, so the next start shows it.

Every option row is shown on its options page: no two options or key bindings share a row, every row is one of the drawn rows, and no page link covers it; the skill reset button (Remake › Interface) can be selected and switched.
The moved skill reset button and Keep mouse in window rows show localized EN/RU/DE labels, help and choices that fit at 1280x720, 2560x1440 and 3840x2160, with native-resolution captures.
Interface boards texture every part by its figure texture group (2 = labels sheet), so the Esc signpost's foot (coloumndetls) uses the labels sheet as in the original instead of smeared stone UVs.

Cut content lists human skins and portraits that no prototype selects (female faces 01, 04, 06, 13, 17, 18) and inventory figures no item record selects; their wiki pages preview the skin on a placed character and the textured model, with EN/RU/DE titles.
The wiki pages of an unused face and an unused item model show localized EN/RU/DE titles and built 3D previews at 1280x720, 2560x1440 and 3840x2160 with native-resolution captures.
